content:
Fractions begin in Class 2 with halves, thirds and quarters — equal parts of a whole. This guide covers what the Maths Olympiad Class 2 fractions chapter tests, the key ideas, the comparison trap, and a free 10-question test.

What the Class 2 Maths Olympiad Fractions chapter tests

  • Equal parts of a whole
  • Half, one-third and one-fourth
  • Identifying and comparing simple fractions
  • A unit fraction of a small number (half of 8)

Key facts your child should know

  • A fraction needs equal parts — the pieces must be the same size.
  • 1/2 is 1 of 2 equal parts; 1/4 is 1 of 4 equal parts.
  • With the same whole, 1/2 > 1/3 > 1/4 — more parts means each is smaller.
  • To find a unit fraction of a number, divide: half of 8 = 8 ÷ 2 = 4.

Common mistakes to avoid

  • Calling unequal parts a fraction.
  • Thinking 1/4 is bigger than 1/2 because 4 is bigger than 2.
  • Confusing the top and bottom numbers.

quiz.title: IMO Class 2 Fractions Quiz
quiz.intro: Ten Olympiad-pattern questions. Pick an answer for each, then press Check my score.

questions.q: Meera cuts 5 oranges into halves. How many half pieces does she get?
questions.explanation: Each whole gives 2 halves, so 5 wholes give 2 x 5 = 10 halves.
4 equal parts are smaller than 3 equal parts of the same whole, so 1/4 is smaller.

questions.q: What do you get when you take 1/3 of 30?
questions.explanation: One-third means 3 equal parts: 30 split into 3 equal parts gives 10 in each part.
Half means 2 equal parts: 56 shared into 2 equal parts gives 28.

questions.q: 1/4 of the 32 crayons in a box are red. How many red crayons are there?
questions.explanation: One-fourth of 32 means 32 split into 4 equal groups: 8 in each group.

questions.q: Zoya painted 1/3 of a fence. What fraction of the fence is not painted yet?
questions.explanation: The fence has 3 equal parts in all: 3/3 - 1/3 = 2/3 is not painted.
Half means 2 equal parts: 64 shared into 2 equal parts gives 32.

questions.q: A tray of barfi has 4 equal pieces and guests eat 3 pieces. What fraction of the barfi is eaten?
questions.explanation: 3 out of 4 equal parts are eaten, so the fraction eaten is 3/4.

questions.q: What is half of half of 20?
Arjun gave 1/3 of his 27 stamps to a friend. How many stamps does he still have?

faq.a: With the same whole, more equal parts makes each part smaller. Two parts are bigger than four, so a half is bigger than a quarter.

faq.q: How do you find half of a number?
faq.a: Divide the number by 2. Half of 8 is 8 ÷ 2 = 4.
